statement: Hurricane Isaias makes at least one US landfall with maximum sustained winds of 96 mph (Category 2) or higher between 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: True if an NHC public advisory or tropical cyclone update issued between 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-15 reports the center of Isaias crossing the US coastline with maximum sustained winds of 96 mph or higher.
failure_condition: Isaias did not cross the US coastline with maximum sustained winds of 96 mph or higher at any time between 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-15.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 100 km of the epicenter of the 2026-10-08 M6.3 Vanuatu earthquake (USGS event us6000u0xi) between 2026-10-09 and 2026-11-08.
resolution: True if the USGS ComCat catalog lists at least one event of magnitude 6.0 or greater with origin time between 2026-10-09 and 2026-11-08 UTC within 100 km of the epicenter of event us6000u0xi.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurred within 100 km of the us6000u0xi epicenter between 2026-10-09 and 2026-11-08 UTC.

statement: A single Russian missile, drone, or glide-bomb attack on one locality in Ukraine kills 20 or more people between 2026-10-09 and 2026-11-15.
resolution: True if Reuters and AP each report that one Russian attack on a single Ukrainian locality, occurring between 2026-10-09 and 2026-11-15, killed at least 20 people, using tolls reported by the deadline.
failure_condition: No single Russian attack on one Ukrainian locality between 2026-10-09 and 2026-11-15 killed 20 or more people.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 of the 435 US House seats in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: True if, by the deadline, the Associated Press has called at least 218 US House races from the 2026-11-03 general election for Democratic candidates.
failure_condition: As of the deadline, fewer than 218 House races from the 2026-11-03 general election had been decided in favor of Democratic candidates.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield is at or above 5.60 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 5.30 percent on the packet date.
resolution: True if FRED series DGS10 shows a value of 5.60 or higher for any date between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 5.30 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The 10-year constant-maturity Treasury yield stayed below 5.60 percent on every trading day between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-31.

statement: The Brent crude spot price reaches 125.00 US dollars per barrel or higher on at least one trading day between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-18. Reference: 105.68 dollars per barrel on the packet date.
resolution: True if FRED series DCOILBRENTEU shows a value of 125.00 or higher for any date between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-18. Reference: 105.68 dollars per barrel on the packet date.
failure_condition: The Brent spot price stayed below 125.00 dollars per barrel on every trading day between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-18.

statement: A new US-Iran ceasefire or truce is announced by the US government and publicly accepted by the Iranian government between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if, between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-31, the White House or State Department announces a US-Iran ceasefire or truce and the Iranian president or foreign ministry publicly accepts it, as reported by Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: No US-Iran ceasefire or truce was both announced by Washington and accepted by Tehran between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-31.

statement: The South Korean ambassador to Ukraine, recalled on 2026-10-08 over the North Korean POW disclosure dispute, or a newly appointed successor, resumes or takes up duties in Kyiv between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if the South Korean foreign ministry or Yonhap reports that ambassador Park Hee-chang or a successor resumed or took up duties at the embassy in Kyiv between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: Neither Park Hee-chang nor any successor resumed or took up ambassadorial duties in Kyiv between 2026-10-09 and 2026-12-31.

statement: CISA adds the CVSS 10.0 SonicWall SMA1000 pre-authentication SSRF flaw patched in early October 2026 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-08 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog holds a SonicWall SMA1000 server-side request forgery entry with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-08 and 2027-01-29. SMA1000 entries added before 2026-10-08 do not count.
failure_condition: No SonicWall SMA1000 server-side request forgery vulnerability was added to the KEV catalog between 2026-10-08 and 2027-01-29.

statement: The MonsterCloud owner charged in early October 2026 with secretly paying ransomware operators while billing victims pleads guilty to at least one count between 2026-10-09 and 2027-03-31.
resolution: True if the court docket in the case or a prosecuting office press release shows the MonsterCloud owner charged in October 2026 entered a guilty plea to any count between 2026-10-09 and 2027-03-31.
failure_condition: The MonsterCloud owner charged in October 2026 entered no guilty plea to any count between 2026-10-09 and 2027-03-31.
